data: Amazon's net sales were about $574.8 billion in fiscal 2023 and about $716.9 billion in fiscal 2025, an increase of roughly $142.1 billion, or about 24.7%. The path between them was $638.0 billion in fiscal 2024 (up about 11% from 2023) and then about 12% growth in 2025. The fiscal 2025 figure comes from my recollection of Amazon's reported results rather than a document I checked here, so confirm it against the 10-K before relying on it.
